sourceTitle: Decreet houdende vaststelling van het wapen van privé-personen en instellingen
locator: 3 February 1998 decree; current consolidated version, Article 2(3°), effective text dated 1 January 2015
original: oud wapen: een heraldisch wapen waarvan kan worden bewezen dat het ten minste honderd jaar geleden publiekelijk werd gevoerd
translation: ‘Older arms’: a heraldic coat of arms for which it can be proved that it was publicly borne at least one hundred years ago.
analysis: The clause defines an older coat of arms through a historical-evidence threshold. It does not establish that an unverified family tale qualifies. Article 3 separately deals with proof of direct male-line descent in an application to recognize older arms. The source is a consolidated legal text and has an amendment history; the wording shown is not a claim that every clause existed unchanged in 1998.
assignment: Explain why demonstrating 100-year public use and demonstrating a modern applicant's entitlement are separate propositions. Find the relevant clause of Article 3 in the Dutch original and paraphrase its evidentiary requirements without reproducing the entire article.

original: Die Eintragung eines Wappens in die Deutsche Wappenrolle hat keine rechtsbegründende Wirkung
translation: The entry of a coat of arms in the Deutsche Wappenrolle has no constitutive legal effect.

vocabulary.translation: effect creating or establishing a legal right

analysis: This is a precise distinction, stated by the register's own governing association. The following part of § 13 describes the evidence and legal protection the society associates with registration, including a reference to § 12 of the German Civil Code. Do not confuse an association's description of a legal relationship with a final judicial ruling about a contested third party. This is stronger evidence than guessing at the register's function by analogy with the English College of Arms.
assignment: Read the whole of § 13 and explain how evidence of use differs from the act that creates a right. Then examine § 11 on how an objection by a third party may interrupt registration.

locator: Hoge Raad van Adel, procedural introduction, first sentence
original: Wapens van publiekrechtelijke lichamen worden verleend bij koninklijk besluit.
translation: Coats of arms of public-law bodies are granted by royal decree.
analysis: The passive construction identifies what is granted, and the legal instrument used. It does not say that every private Dutch family's arms requires the same procedure. Elsewhere the Council describes an advisory stage, the royal decision, and the resulting armorial diploma as separate steps. Note that this source is an institution's current procedural account, not a medieval grant itself.
assignment: Trace the process from application to Council advice, royal decree and wapendiploma; explain which stage creates an administrative decision and which documents or illustrates it.

sourceTitle: Resolución de 28 de septiembre de 1998 ... Sotillo de la Ribera
locator: BOE-A-1998-23942, section Primero, published 15 October 1998, p. 34218
original: Escudo partido de una línea y cortado de dos, formando seis cuarteles.
translation: A shield divided by one vertical line and crossed by two horizontal divisions, forming six compartments.

vocabulary.translation: heraldic compartments (here, six rather than four)

analysis: The original specifies a two-by-three arrangement. Rendering cuarteles as 'quarters' without explanation might convince an English reader that the shield has precisely four sections; here it has six. This is a public-body act, not a generic family armorial. The same document provides tinctures, charges and the royal crown; an exact full rendering would require reading all of section Primero.
assignment: Draw a blank two-by-three shield. Using the remainder of the Spanish official text, identify the castle, lion and holm oak compartments, preserving the printed tincture vocabulary. Compare your diagram with a printed contemporary illustration if its provenance can be established.

locator: Archivio Centrale dello Stato quoting the Italian Constitution, XIV transitional and final provision; archive note dated 19 October 2015
original: I titoli nobiliari non sono riconosciuti.
translation: Titles of nobility are not recognized.
analysis: The sentence addresses noble titles under the Italian constitutional settlement. It does not say that all old documents of armorial rights vanished or that historical coats of arms ceased being objects of study. The same archive preserves the original pre-Republic Libro d'oro and records of the former Consulta araldica. The second sentence of the constitutional passage, concerning some older nobiliary predicates as parts of names, requires separate reading.
assignment: Distinguish a record of recognition under the former Kingdom, recognition of noble titles under the post-1948 Constitution, and the historical study of arms. What claim can the Golden Book prove that it cannot legally re-create?

original: Il regroupe 3 séries de manuscrits : 2 séries de textes
translation: It brings together three manuscript series: two series of texts.

vocabulary.translation: painted depictions of coats of arms

analysis: The immediately following guide identifies the third series as coloured arms, and provides distinct shelfmark spans for the textual and painted volumes. A modern catalogue result that points to a painted blazon may not itself be the registration text. This is a key distinction for graduate datasets and archival citation: the source describing the collection is not a substitute for the item within that collection.

sourceTitle: 家紋・紋章を調べる（日本）
locator: National Diet Library Research Navi, section 2.1 and 2.2; page updated 17 December 2025
original: 文様から探す / 姓氏から探す
translation: Search by motif / Search by family name.

vocabulary.translation: to look up or search for

analysis: These headings represent two complementary ways of entering a bibliography of family emblems: by what the design looks like and by the family name associated with it. The library explicitly lists separate reference works for the two methods. The two lookup routes are not proof that every holder of a Japanese surname possesses one unique kamon. A terminology-aware index retains Japanese script, transliteration and the distinction between original and normalized names.
assignment: Use the NDL's original Japanese sections 2.1 and 2.2 to identify two different reference works, preserving their Japanese titles and catalog call numbers. Explain how the choice of index could introduce different selection and attribution errors.

locator: Article 6(1), description of the Ministry of Culture's armorial register, current consolidated wording
original: Kultūras ministrija veido, uztur un papildina Ģerboņu reģistru
translation: The Ministry of Culture establishes, maintains and adds to the Register of Coats of Arms.

vocabulary.translation: Register of Coats of Arms (accusative form)

analysis: The grammatical subject is the Ministry of Culture; the verbs express its duties in relation to the official armorial register. This clause describes administration, not the committee's separate artistic assessment or a legal conclusion about a specific claimant. The full article describes registry records, some of which concern sensitive information about private persons. Our teaching database intentionally avoids importing personal identifiers.
assignment: Identify the separate roles of Ministry and State Heraldry Commission in Articles 4–6, then explain why the registrar's duty to maintain records should not be interpreted as proof that all historical armorial uses predated registration.

sourceTitle: Lietuvos Respublikos valstybės herbo, kitų herbų ir herbinių ženklų įstatymas
locator: Article 10(1) of consolidated legislation, including the 2019 ethnographic-region amendment
original: Apskričių, savivaldybių, etnografinių regionų, miestų, miestelių ir kaimų herbų etalonus Lietuvos heraldikos komisijos teikimu tvirtina Respublikos Prezidentas.
translation: The President of the Republic approves the official standards for the coats of arms of counties, municipalities, ethnographic regions, cities, towns and villages on the proposal of the Lithuanian Heraldry Commission.

vocabulary.translation: official standards or exemplars of coats of arms (accusative plural)

analysis: The operative legal act here is presidential approval of armorial standards following a heraldic commission's proposal, not a generic granting of personal heraldry. The phrase etnografinių regionų was incorporated by amendment; the exact consolidated version matters. In a research database, an approved visual standard should be distinguished from an earlier historical depiction with similar symbols.
assignment: Make a parallel Lithuanian–English flowchart identifying which body proposes and which approves the official standards. Explain why translating etalonas as an ordinary drawing would miss the administrative force of the sentence.

locator: 2015 Municipalities Act, Section 5, first and second sentences
original: Kunnalla voi olla valtuuston hyväksymä kunnanvaakuna. Ennen vaakunan hyväksymistä kunnan on hankittava Kansallisarkiston lausunto.
translation: A municipality may have a coat of arms approved by its council. Before approving the arms, the municipality must obtain an opinion from the National Archives.

vocabulary.translation: an opinion from the National Archives (genitive form)

analysis: The source separates three functions: the municipal council approves its arms, the National Archives gives an expert opinion that must be sought beforehand, and the municipal administration separately oversees use. Simply calling this the Finnish version of an English heraldic grant loses the statutory structure. The 1995 Municipalities Act carried a similar rule in Section 6; date the law you quote.
assignment: Write a one-paragraph comparison of the 2015 Section 5 and the 1995 Section 6 provisions in the original Finnish, noting the approving body and the archive's role. Why is the distinction between an opinion and a legal approval important?
